headline: A daughter saves her dad's shoe shop

sources.title: Daughter Saves Dad's Struggling Shoe Shop With TikTok Appeal
Watch: viral TikToks save Shoreditch's last shoe shop
Hidden gem shoe shop goes viral thanks to supporters, now with long queues

chunks.text: For more than twenty years, Rachid Lazraq has {{looked after}} a small shoe shop called Rich Collection Italia on Hackney Road in East London. The shop sells [[stylish]] Italian shoes, but in recent years [[business]] had slowly {{dried up}}. Most people had started buying online, and fewer and fewer [[customers]] came through the door. Sad and tired, Rachid had almost decided to {{shut down}} the shop [[for good]].

verbs.wrong: To lose money on every sale

verbs.correct: To close a business for good
verbs.wrong: To sell the shop to someone

chunks.text: His daughter, who is 25 and works as a [[journalist]], did not want to {{give up}} on the family business. She had {{found out}} that a French [[influencer]] had shown the shop online, so she {{came up with}} a simple idea. On July 7, she posted a short [[video]] on TikTok about the shop's Y2K [[sandals]], a [[style]] from the early 2000s that is [[popular]] again.

verbs.wrong: To run out of all your money

verbs.correct: To learn a fact or the truth
verbs.wrong: To read posts on social media

verbs.correct: To think of a new idea

chunks.text: The video quickly {{took off}}. [[Overnight]], it {{racked up}} 300,000 [[views]], and soon young customers were {{lining up}} outside the shop, sometimes waiting two hours to get inside. In just a few days, the whole business had {{turned around}}. The quiet little shop that was about to close was suddenly full of life.

verbs.wrong: To be posted early in the morning

verbs.correct: To form a line and wait
To change from bad to good
verbs.wrong: To move a shop somewhere new

chunks.text: The best moment came when Rachid {{took down}} the 'Closing Sale' [[sign]] while happy customers {{cheered him on}}. His daughter, who had hated to watch the shop [[struggle]], could [[hardly]] believe how quickly things had changed. Now the family is even {{looking into}} selling their Italian shoes online. One short video had {{brought back}} the [[crowds]] and given a [[much loved]] little shop a [[second chance]].
